items.title: Choose the action in progress
items.instructions: Choose the sentence that presents reading as ongoing at a past time.

options.text: At five, I was reading the notice.
At five, I read the notice tomorrow.
At five, I am read the notice.

payload.explanation: Was reading marks an action in progress around five in the past.

items.title: Complete the background action
items.instructions: Complete the sentence with the past continuous form of wait.

payload.stimulus: I ___ for the bus when my phone rang.
payload.explanation: Was waiting supplies the ongoing background action.
payload.spelling_policy: Require the two-word form was waiting.

items.title: Read and relay travel facts
items.instructions: Read the notice and answer with all three requested facts.

payload.stimulus: Travel notice: Train 6 departs at 7:40 from Platform 2.

questions.text: What should you tell a friend who cannot see the notice?

items.title: Listen for the request details
items.instructions: Use the transcript as a listening script and identify the requested help.

payload.transcript: At the ticket desk, a traveller says, ‘Excuse me, could you help me find Platform 5, please?’

questions.text: What does the traveller need help finding?

items.title: Report while asking for help
items.instructions: Explain what you were doing, then ask station staff for help.

payload.communicative_goal: Combine a brief past background with a suitable request to staff.
constraints: Use was or were plus an -ing form.
payload.expected_output: Two connected sentences: background action and polite request.

rubric.criterion: The ongoing past action has a correct past-continuous form.
The request is respectful and specific.
